newsitem.title: USA: BAESA in restructing pact with creditors.
newsitem.headline: BAESA in restructing pact with creditors.

text.p: Buenos Aires Embotelladora said on Tuesday that it reached an agreement in principle with its main creditors in Argentina on a comprehensive financial restructuring.

"Consumation of the financial restructuring would restore BAESA's positive net worth and will remove the risk of a mandatory filing of an insolvency proceeding by BAESA under Argentine law," the company said in a statement.

Under the terms of the agreement, BAESA's unsecured lenders in Argentina will exchange about $650 million existing debt for at least 98 percent of the equity in the company and for about $300 million of new debt, the company said.
Regarding upcoming earnings results, the company said it would record a charge of roughly $190 million in the quarter ending June 30 to reduce the carrying value of its Brazilian operations.
The company, which, has exclusive rights to produce and sell PepsiCo products in Buenos Aires, expects to release its fiscal third quarter results in early August.
